design_note: Paired common-random-number Monte Carlo study. Each dataset is reused across all prior variants within each DGP and sample-size cell. The working likelihood is independent Normal(theta, 1). The heteroskedastic case is independent but non-identically distributed; no serial or cluster dependence is simulated. All contamination mixtures share their nominal component's location, so they reduce concentration but do not correct prior-centre misspecification. This is a finite-simulation GDS study, not an exact replication of Li and Rice (2024).
experiment: GDS prior-location and diffuse-contamination robustness stress grid

scenario_descriptions.heteroskedastic_normal_var4: Independent Normal observations with deterministic row-specific scales, average variance 4.
